headline: Murray's 45 and Jokić's triple-double win it in overtime
dek: Jamal Murray scored 45 and Nikola Jokić had a 37-point triple-double as Denver won overtime 20–14.
three: 13 of 22 from the field, 13 of 14 at the line, 7 assists and 6 points in overtime.
Nuggets up 10 after three, tied 131–131 at the end of regulation, then won overtime 20–14
Murray and Jokić combined for 82 of 151.
Won it in the paint and on the offensive glass
Points in the paint 66–48; second-chance points 25–11. Chicago made 25 threes, tying its franchise record, and still lost.
